replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
After being reviewed, we have come to a final verdict: this player will not be banned as there was not any sufficient evidence provided. In the future, please try and get a spectator point of view for better clarification (or a cleaner in-game point of view)
Anyways, we'll try to keep an eye out for him.
Thanks and have a wonderful day!
